the_full_game.title: UFOlogy, Yes, it's all real
the_full_game.description:
Heyo. This is a book that likely would have had relics if i was better at managing my time lol. Idk. Maybe if theres enough interest on this game, I would definently be down to continuing this project (rather than working than my pre-existing junk lol). So let me know if you like this game! :D
		This book would have had relics Themed around more pop-culturey 'strange magic things'. Like alien sighting photos, mothman fluff, bigfoot 'replica', and a bent spoon.
		There was also going to be a joke thats like the opposite of the Creator painting found in art history volume 1, where instead of it being 'a painting from another world thats more art than it is occult', its 'a painting from another world thats more occult than it is art', and its just some irl painting copy and pasted. really high quality, clashes with style, etc.
